title: CiteAnchor: Source-Aware Grounding for Hallucinated Citation Detection and Resolution
abstract: arXiv:2610.30355v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hallucinated citations make it harder to trace sources and verify the evidence behind scientific claims. Detecting them is difficult because bibliographic records can be incomplete or differ across source types and publication versions. A plausible match alone neither validates the citation nor establishes its underlying source. We introduce CiteResolve, a benchmark of 423 real-world hallucinated citations annotated for source recoverability. We further propose CiteAnchor, a source-aware grounding framework that adapts retrieval and field-level verification to each source type and separately determines citation validity and whether a unique source can be recovered. On an existing detection benchmark, CiteAnchor achieves 0.841 F1 with GPT-5.6 Luna and 0.784 with an open-weight backbone, outperforming the baseline with the same backbones by 7.9 and 36.8 points. translated_title: CiteAnchor：面向幻觉引用检测与溯源的来源感知定位框架
translated_abstract: 幻觉引用使得追溯来源和验证科学论断背后的证据变得更加困难。检测幻觉引用之所以困难，是因为书目记录可能不完整，或在不同来源类型和出版版本之间存在差异。仅仅一个看似合理的匹配既无法验证引用的有效性，也无法确定其底层来源。我们提出了CiteResolve，这是一个包含423条真实世界幻觉引用的基准数据集，并针对来源可恢复性进行了标注。我们进一步提出CiteAnchor，这是一个来源感知的定位框架，它根据每种来源类型自适应地调整检索和字段级验证，并分别判定引用的有效性以及是否能够恢复出唯一的来源。在现有检测基准上，CiteAnchor使用GPT-5.6 Luna达到0.841的F1分数，使用开放权重骨干模型达到0.784，相比使用相同骨干模型的基线分别提升了7.9分和36.8分。在CiteResolve上，它实现了74.7%和70.7%的端到端任务成功率（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出了包含423条真实幻觉引用的CiteResolve基准和来源感知定位框架CiteAnchor，通过针对不同来源类型自适应的检索与字段级验证，分别判定引用有效性并恢复唯一来源，在检测与端到端溯源任务上均显著超越基线。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CiteResolve, a benchmark of 423 real-world hallucinated citations, and CiteAnchor, a source-aware grounding framework that adapts retrieval and field-level verification to each source type, jointly detecting hallucinated citations and recovering their unique sources with substantial gains over baselines.
